review.description: S4/S5 preserve the exact resolved hosted comparison before interruptible metadata collection. Existing fixture-only dispatch, source identity, cancellation outcomes and unavailable bootstrap comparison semantics remain intact; workflow delivery is a later part.
review.implementation: Inspected ci.run_verification selecting the existing journal, persisting the resolved plan before Journal.refresh collects versions, and entering existing bootstrap handling. Heavy suite commands and fixture environment are unchanged; no manifest observer or workflow upload is introduced here.
review.tests: Read the real selected-journal dispatcher assertions for push, PR, manual-main and reviewed-root success/failure: exact plan and source survive, fixture0 and nonzero worker status remain authoritative, and identity/comparison parsing is not repeated. KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit143 during versions preserve the same exception, start no worker and retain an interrupted partial. Existing CI tests explicitly isolate ambient selected journals.
